title: Almost perfect graph classes
summary: A graph $G$ is perfect if $ω(H) = χ(H)$ for each induced subgraph $H$ of $G$. In 2002, Chudnovsky, Robertson, Seymour, and Thomas famously proved the Strong Perfect Graph Theorem. Motivated by this forbidden induced subgraph characterization of the class of perfect graphs as well as the possible extension of efficient algorithms on perfect graphs, we consider the structure of graphs that are almost perfect.
